settings.definition:
Tenderness, compassion, and loving kindness.
The gift of a mother’s heart.
settings.subtitle: Timeless abayas for every woman, thoughtfully designed with discreet nursing-friendly features and uncompromising elegance.

settings.heading: For every day, and every occasion
Button opening
settings.body: A carefully placed press button opening at the top of the abaya allows easy breastfeeding access, while the rest of the abaya remains fully closed for complete coverage.
settings.image_alt: Illustration of the abaya showing a press button opening at the top of the neck, around a quarter of the way down below the chest.

settings.heading: Zip fastening
settings.body: A discreet zip fastening at the top provides quick and convenient nursing access, thoughtfully incorporated into the design while maintaining the abaya’s elegant silhouette.
settings.image_alt: Illustration of the abaya showing a zip running down the centre of the neck, around a quarter of the way down below the chest.

settings.heading: Side chest seams zips
settings.body: Subtle openings incorporated into the chest seams on both sides provide easy access for breastfeeding, while keeping the rest of the abaya beautifully closed and modest.
settings.image_alt: Illustration of the abaya showing concealed zips set into the chest seams on either side of the chest.

settings.heading: Thoughtful details
settings.subheading: Discreet nursing access, designed for you.
